summary: string-format-kit postinstall exfiltrates cloud IAM credentials and host identity to attacker OOB host
details: On npm install, package.json scripts.postinstall runs postinstall.js, which uses child_process.exec to shell out to curl and probe multi-cloud instance metadata endpoints (AWS 169.254.169.254, Aliyun, Tencent, GCP, Azure). It retrieves the AWS IAM role's temporary security credentials from IMDS, writes them to /tmp/.iam-creds, and appends hostname, whoami output, instance identifiers, and the IAM credential blob to a query string sent to a hardcoded Burp Collaborator out-of-band host (pzs5w7ntzhsnepwk564lyfdci3oucl0a.oastify.com). The advertised purpose (string formatting) has no relation to cloud metadata access or credential collection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
